correctness.rationale: Exact entrance conditioning gives a uniform onto word on n−1 colors. A zero-truncated-Poisson conditional occupancy model plus span-one lattice local CLT bounds conditional one-color counts uniformly. Singleton count concentration and exchangeable positions give unit-rate Poisson local point process. The probability of a multiply occurring color entirely expiring in the first t=O(n^alpha) positions is O(n^(alpha−1)); the chance of rescuing one of O_P(1) expiring colors is O(n^(alpha−1)). Their union-bound sandwich yields the exponential first-exit law. Stationary mass divided by flux gives the exact mean and the singleton exit-hazard supplies its n^alpha asymptotic. The 403 exact checker assertions only validate finite combinatorics.

value.rationale: The probability of currently having all coupons and the probability per step of entering that state differ by a stochastic episode length. In the rare subcritical setting, earlier flux analysis does not specify how long successful coverage persists. The unit-rate spatial singleton clock and exponential Palm lifetime give the natural missing local temporal structure for every fixed alpha in (0,1), not merely a routine expectation identity or unmotivated finite statistic.
